note: One of the 48 segments of the round monorail loop (INTERFACES 'Wave 4.1b', highway.round): 7.5 degrees of a circle of radius 56. monorail-kit is generated by tools/assets/monorail_kit.py in STUDS, scale 1.0. Origin = the segment's middle, on the circle, at ground level. At rotY 0 the beam's tangent at the origin is local X and the circle's centre is at local (0, 0, +56): the piece bows toward +Z and its outer face looks to -Z. Both ends are cut on the circle's radii, so 48 copies close the loop with no gap and no overlap. To seat the segment whose middle is at angle t from the plot's +X (t = 3.75 + 7.5 k degrees): position (56 cos t, 0, 56 sin t) from the circle's centre, rotationY = -(t + 90) degrees. Same beam as MonorailTrack: 1.6 wide, top = wheel plane 7.07 (= highway.deckHeight), soffit 6.10; its stripe, rail and joint band stand 0.05 off the beam. One pier at the origin, saddle across the beam.
